description: This file contains the NotesProvider class which manages the state and network interactions for notes in a Flutter application. It provides methods to load, refresh, search, get, create, update, and delete notes via HTTP requests to a backend API. It also defines getters for filtered notes based on search criteria and handles notifying listeners on state changes.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based class that acts as a provider for notes, managing state, fetching data from an API, and providing methods for CRUD operations.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the backend API, optionally filtered by the current search string, and updates the internal list of notes.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Alias for loadNotes, used to refresh the notes list.

methods.name: setSearch
methods.description: Sets the search string and triggers loading notes based on the new search filter.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID from the backend.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with given title and content, then reloads the notes list.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new title and content, then reloads notes.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID and refreshes the notes list.
